_comment: A worked example of the situation report, from the island's position on September 14, 2026 after Hurricane Lowell. An administrator loads it from /admin/help as a starting point and edits every line; nothing in it is fetched or kept current by the app. Area levels are one reading of the county's September 14 update, not the county's own rating.

briefing.title: Hurricane Lowell recovery
briefing.lead: Hawaiʻi Tourism Authority encourages upcoming visitors to reschedule or choose another island while recovery continues. Islandwide water conservation remains in effect, including where power has returned.
briefing.note: Recovery dates may change. Check the official updates below before you go anywhere that was closed.

items.title: Flights
items.headline: Līhuʻe Airport is open
items.details: Check your flight with your airline before leaving.

items.title: Roads
items.headline: Drive only when necessary
items.details: Cleanup traffic islandwide. Kūhiō Highway past Princeville is local traffic only; Halewili Road is closed between Kalāheo and Kauaʻi Coffee.

items.title: Power & water
items.headline: Some outages remain. Conserve water.
items.details: The boil-water notices for Kīlauea and Wainiha–Hāʻena were lifted September 11–12. Water conservation continues islandwide.

items.title: Beaches & parks
items.headline: Plan for closures
items.details: County and state parks are closed. A brown-water advisory remains islandwide.

items.title: Waimea / Kekaha
items.headline: Expect cleanup traffic; drive only when necessary.
items.powerWater: Confirm power where you are going; water conservation continues.
items.beachesParks: County and state parks closed; brown-water advisory continues.

items.title: Hanapēpē / ʻEleʻele
items.headline: Confirm any boat tour before you drive down.
items.gettingAround: Halewili Road access available from the ʻEleʻele side.
items.powerWater: Outages remain in parts of Hanapēpē; conserve water.
items.beachesParks: Port Allen tour restart unconfirmed; parks closed; brown-water advisory continues.

items.title: Kalāheo / Lāwaʻi
items.headline: Get current directions before setting out.
items.gettingAround: Halewili Road closed between Kalāheo and Kauaʻi Coffee.
items.powerWater: Some local outages remain; water conservation continues.
items.beachesParks: County and state parks closed; brown-water advisory continues.

items.title: Poʻipū / Kōloa
items.headline: Cleanup continues; limit driving to necessary trips.
items.gettingAround: Cleanup traffic; limit driving to necessary trips.
items.powerWater: Outages remain in parts of Poʻipū; conserve water.
items.beachesParks: County and state parks closed; brown-water advisory continues.

items.title: Līhuʻe / Hanamāulu
items.headline: Airport open; outages remain in places.
items.powerWater: Outages remain in parts of Līhuʻe; conserve water.
items.beachesParks: County and state parks closed; brown-water advisory continues.

items.title: Kapaʻa / Wailua
items.headline: Roads cleared; bridge work resumes September 20.
items.gettingAround: Kuamoʻo Road cleared; Wailua bridge debris work resumes September 20.
items.powerWater: Some outages remain in Kapaʻa and Wailua; conserve water.
items.beachesParks: County and state parks closed; brown-water advisory continues.

items.title: Anahola / Moloaʻa
items.headline: Cleanup continues; drive only when necessary.
items.gettingAround: Cleanup continues; drive only when necessary.
items.powerWater: Outages remain in parts of Anahola; conserve water.
items.beachesParks: County and state parks closed; brown-water advisory continues.

items.title: Kīlauea / ʻAnini
items.headline: Allow for bridge lane shifts on the way to ʻAnini.
items.gettingAround: Kalihiwai Bridge lane shifts September 15, 8:30 a.m.–3 p.m.
items.powerWater: North Shore restoration remains incomplete; water conservation continues. Kīlauea boil notice lifted September 12.
items.beachesParks: County and state parks closed; brown-water advisory continues.

items.title: Princeville
items.headline: The highway past here is open to local traffic only.
items.gettingAround: Kūhiō Highway toward Keʻe is open to local traffic only.
items.powerWater: Power restoration continues; water conservation remains in effect.
items.beachesParks: County and state parks closed; brown-water advisory continues.

items.title: Hanalei
items.headline: Local traffic only. Confirm access before heading in.
items.gettingAround: Local traffic only; the Hanalei Bridge lane closure has no end date.
items.powerWater: Power restoration continues; water conservation remains in effect.
items.beachesParks: County and state parks closed; brown-water advisory continues.

items.title: Wainiha / Hāʻena
items.headline: Local traffic only; the bridges have a weight limit.
items.gettingAround: Local traffic only; the Wainiha double bridges have a five-ton limit.
items.powerWater: North Shore restoration remains incomplete; water conservation continues. Boil notice lifted September 11.
items.beachesParks: Hāʻena and Nā Pali Coast state parks closed; brown-water advisory continues.

items.title: Waimea Canyon / Kōkeʻe
items.headline: Wait for an official reopening before planning a visit.
items.gettingAround: Canyon and Kōkeʻe roads are still being cleared.
items.powerWater: Kōkeʻe last reported without power September 13; conserve water.
items.beachesParks: State parks and camping closed until further notice.

items.title: September 14–20
items.details: Cleanup continues islandwide: parks closed, brown-water advisory in effect, local outages remain. Kalihiwai Bridge lane shifts September 15; Wailua bridge debris work resumes September 20.
items.recheck: Daily — the county posts an update most days.

items.title: September 21–30
items.details: Keep plans conditional on the current advisory, road access and completed repairs. No islandwide reopening date has been published.

items.title: October 1–31
items.details: HDOT describes temporary Wainiha bridge abutment work within October. That is a construction window, not a date for unrestricted North Shore access.

items.title: November 1–14
items.details: No verified official date establishes full recovery by then. Do not count on normal parks, tours, utilities or access.

items.title: Should I travel to Kauaʻi now?
items.details: Hawaiʻi Tourism Authority encourages upcoming travellers to reschedule or choose another island while recovery continues. The advice is not a ban on entering the island, and no end date is published. Talk to your airline and to wherever you are staying.

items.title: What about October or early November?
items.details: There is no confirmed islandwide reopening date. Wainiha temporary bridge repairs are planned during October, but unrestricted access is not promised. Check again before any deadline you have.

items.title: Can I reach Hanalei or Hāʻena?
items.details: The county lists Princeville to Keʻe as local traffic only, and the Wainiha bridges have a five-ton limit. Confirm that your trip is permitted before setting out.

items.title: Is there power and water?
items.details: Service varies by address. Islandwide water conservation remains in effect, including where power has returned.

items.title: Do I still need to boil tap water?
items.details: The Kīlauea Department of Water boil notice was lifted September 12, and Wainiha–Hāʻena's on September 11. Water conservation still applies. If your water comes from a private system, check with its operator.

items.title: Can I swim or visit parks?
items.details: County and state parks remain closed. A brown-water advisory continues islandwide: avoid murky water and ocean areas near stream mouths, drains and harbours. Follow posted closures.

items.title: Are flights and boat tours running?
items.details: Līhuʻe Airport is fully operational; confirm your flight with your airline. Port Allen's September 13 charter suspension has no verified restart date. Confirm every boat tour with its operator.

items.title: How can I keep up with changes?
items.details: Check the county, KIUC and State Parks updates below. Sign up for Kauaʻi alerts by texting KAUAIEMA to 888777. Keep driving to necessary trips during recovery.
